meta.title: Texans at Browns
meta.td_note: Market = the DraftKings anytime TD price quoted by ESPN on Nov 13. Only players with a quoted price get a call, and nobody listed as questionable gets one. Confirm the price in your own book first: the call only holds at the price shown or longer.

weather.note: Cleveland, 1 PM kickoff: about 45°F. Wunderground’s hourly forecast has roughly a 40 to 60% chance of rain through the game window and 60% for the day, with NNW winds of 10 to 20 mph. The daily weather tool is lower at 35%. Either way it is over the 30% line.
weather.effect: Real rain risk: steer away from receiving-yard overs, especially secondary targets, and toward rushing volume, receptions or unders. The sim trims passing and scoring for rain at about half weight plus some wind.

injuries: HOU Marvin Harrison Jr. (WR): Out, Hamstring

notes: Deshaun Watson starts after clearing concussion protocol; coach Todd Monken confirmed it Wednesday.
